article.title: 〜ず sin hacer
article.chapter: Gramática literaria y clásica para reconocimiento — 文語・古典文法の認識

claims.summary: Classical negative auxiliary ず attaches to 未然形 and has a paradigm with forms such as ぬ, ね and the ざり series.

The inspected contemporary Japanese study describes ず in connective patterns ～ずに and ～ず、～, with examples such as 手を使わずに冷蔵庫のドアを閉める and ドアを閉めずに出て行った; it distinguishes these from sentence-final ordinary negation with ない.
The public classical grammar guide gives 所定めずまどひ歩き as an example of negative ず and provides the auxiliary’s conjugation table.

locator.description: Kotobank, デジタル大辞泉, lines 15–21: defines ず as attaching to 未然形 for negative judgment and gives the ざり paradigm and ず/ぬ series.

links.notes: Describes dictionary grammar and inflection, without asserting each modern verb example.

locator.description: 古典文法講座 第九回, PDF p. 2, lines 57–70: meaning “negative”, modern use note, and paradigm ず/ぬ/ね plus ざら/ざり/ざる/ざれ.

links.notes: Used as a public instructional reference for the classical paradigm.

locator.description: 吉永 (2010), PDF p. 8, lines 224–239: current connective use, exact examples 手を使わずに冷蔵庫のドアを閉める and ドアを閉めずに出て行った; PDF p. 10, lines 280–305 contrasts modern ず patterns with ない and sentence-final negation.
